items.content:
Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
CONTROLS (observed): WASD moves; hold ~1s shifts world ~100px; character stays screen-centered. Space = contextual action (pick). Mouse hover over a target shows a verb label ('Pick X' near, 'Examine X' far); clicking scenery does nothing useful. Escape = Paused menu. Tab = map (guess, untested). Left-click the flame icon in the craft sidebar to open the recipe column. Craft UI open does NOT pause time. Keyboard A/D do NOT navigate the craft panel — pressing D moved the character instead (panel not keyboard-driven/not modal).

PICKING/REACH (observed): a 'Pick X' label can appear at long range yet the pick silently fails — ~250-260px failed twice in a row on a grass tuft even with a longer 0.5s Space hold; ~115px left and ~130px diagonal succeeded for grass and sapling. So verb label is not a range guarantee; approach to roughly 100-130px. Standing on a target flips Pick to Examine; step off/back. Confirmed yields: yellow flower -> Petals; red flower -> Petals (a red ground sprite that looked like a mushroom turned out to be a red flower); sapling -> Twigs x1 (so 2+ saplings needed); grass tuft -> Cut Grass x1. Depleted saplings render as bare leafless branches with no verb. Pine needle clusters beside trunks AND pine trunks themselves both read 'Examine Evergreen' — they mimic bright yellow-green grass tufts; real tufts are distinct spiky ground clumps, often at pine bases. No-verb scenery: small sprigs, button bushes, bare branches; red mushrooms pickability still untested.

UNRESOLVED: after the two failed long-range Space presses the tuft looked wilted and then showed no verb, yet no hotbar slot appeared; could mean harvest without UI update, or the tuft was depleted/animation. Do not trust hotbar counts blindly.

HOTBAR (observed): fills in acquisition order; slot centers x~0.135, 0.20, 0.26, 0.32 at y~0.93. Tooltips almost never render, so counts stay unreadable; green icons are ambiguous (Petals vs Cut Grass vs Twigs). Hover-verify but expect failures.

CRAFT UI (observed, repeatedly): flame 'Light' icon ~(0.019,0.197); left click opens vertical recipe column x~0.05-0.15. After opening, bright-looking tiles appeared near top y~0.12 and bottom y~0.885, with dark silhouette tiles between at y~0.20, 0.30, 0.40, 0.51. Many hover and left-click attempts on the bright top and bright bottom tiles across several runs produced no detail panel and no crafting effect whatsoever. Hypotheses: bright top/bottom tiles may be decorative end-caps and the dark tiles are the actual recipes (earlier guess 'bright = affordable' now doubted); or activation needs a different input (right click, double click, drag); or clicking a tile crafts directly and it silently failed for lack of materials. Assumed unverified costs: Torch 2 Cut Grass + 2 Twigs; Campfire 3 Cut Grass + 2 Logs; Fire Pit rocks + unknown. Unknown whether column scrolls or recipes unlock.

NIGHT (observed): dusk message 'It's getting late. It will be dark soon.' then 'It's so dark!' with repeated 'OW! Something hit me!' / 'What was that?!' and red damage vignette until death. A blue circular (moon) icon appears beside the Day clock at night, function unknown. Pressing F (attack guess) had no observed effect. Night without light killed the character; no torch was craftable because only 1 Twig had been gathered. A lit torch held in daylight previously survived Night 1.

HUNGER (observed): 'I'm so hungry!' warning appears; Petals hover shows 'Eat'. Whether eating petals restores hunger is untested.

TERRAIN/NAVIGATION (observed): start area = open brown burrow-heavy ground, rabbit holes, yellow flowers, red mushrooms, butterflies, birds, sparse saplings. Long east/southeast runs crossed burrow savanna without any grass field. Pine barrens hold grass tufts at trunk bases, but many pines encountered were bare/depleted. After long travel west/southwest a richer cluster field appeared (several grass tufts at ~0.10-0.24 x on screen, a sapling, red and yellow flowers) — best harvest spot found; worth heading that direction again. Yellow and red flowers are reliable Petal sources at close range.

FAILED/WASTEFUL (observed): click-to-harvest; Space beyond ~150px; standing on target; hovering trunks/needles; treating ground sprigs/sprigs/button bushes as pickable; spending late daylight on unresponsive craft UI; testing keyboard craft navigation; clicking bright end-cap tiles; wandering in darkness; starting crafting at dusk; assuming all green icons are Cut Grass.

LESSONS FOR NEXT ATTEMPT (hypotheses, unverified): daylight is a hard deadline — gather immediately and get 3+ Twigs and 3+ Cut Grass (surplus, since labels/counts lie) well before dusk; craft light in early/mid afternoon when the UI can still be debugged in daylight; try alternative activation (right-click, double-click) on recipe tiles; consider that the detail panel may never exist and a single precise click is the craft action; confirm each pick by walking to the target first (~100-130px). Open questions: what the blue moon icon does, whether petals/berries/mushrooms are food and how eating works, whether F attacks, whether the recipe column scrolls, and whether a fire/campfire is a cheap alternative to the torch.
